fields.title: Replace Python-era Rust API names with behavior-based names

data.text: Inventory: PyInt and six py_* helper names span 24 Rust files. Preserve format-1 boolean/integer fields, numeric parsing, Unicode whitespace, and byte-preserving URL normalization; rename APIs by behavior and document the contracts. Baseline running before edits.

Expanded scope per user: rewrite port-history comments throughout Rust source and tests. Stacked branch roll-dih8.17-rust-names on PR #2 head 08292dd. Pristine PR2 baseline: 782 passed, 1 pre-existing failure in hardening::v1::v1_push_side_translation::git_keeps_the_rejection_tokens_bead_reads_untranslated; git returned failed to update ref instead of the expected token. Original branch baseline and initial rename baseline both passed 772 tests.

Cleanup complete on roll-dih8.17-rust-names, based directly on PR #2 head 08292dd. Renamed PyInt to IntegerField, py_* text helpers to operation names, and pathlib helpers to normalize_path/join_path; rewrote port-history comments throughout Rust source while retaining fixture and generator provenance. Final fmt and strict workspace Clippy pass. ./check.sh: 782 passed, 1 failed, 3 skipped; 14 infra tests pass. The sole failure is the V1 Git rejection-token test, reproduced on pristine PR #2 before applying changes: git 2.43.0 emits failed to update ref instead of incorrect old value provided. This is the existing roll-k2wy.17 issue. Preparing a draft PR stacked on #2; no runtime or format changes.

Draft PR #3 is published: https://github.com/bpcakes/beadroll/pull/3 . Its base is roll-lqjj-follow-ups (PR #2), with one cleanup commit f9e223a. Working tree is clean. Validation and the inherited roll-k2wy.17 Git-message failure are documented in the PR. Leaving this issue open until the stack is merged to main.
